name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses capture the task. Existence(target_picked_up) with the Precedence chain (door_open before target, has_door_key before door_open, blocker_moved before has_door_key) forces every earlier step, so no redundant Existence clauses are needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', and the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches the 'Whenever holding the key, try to...' wording. All priorities match their preference cues.

texts: Move the ball away from the door before taking the key.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards.
Open the door with the matching key, so the key is acquired before or when the door is opened.
Open the door before picking up the target box.
